Huarong Road

Sliding-block puzzle · 100 graded levels · exact par for every level

How it works
  1. Set up — copy the layout shown on the LED. Place each block; its “chip” turns green when it sits in the right spot.
  2. Slide — drag blocks into the empty space.
  3. Escape — guide the big red square out through the green exit at the bottom.
